changelog.summary: Added taxonomyIds to 6 domain(s) — cross-vertical relationship discovery metadata (IDEA-0008 Phase 4), aggregated + alias-resolved from each domain's own question tags. No question/notes/scenario content changed.

Syllabus refresh against the GH-300 skills measured as of August 7, 2026 (domains and weights unchanged; D2 task statements updated for Copilot CLI, agent sessions/subagents, prompt files and code review policies). Merged 21 gh300-only questions and 69 unique questions from three unreferenced ghc files (186 -> 276); tagged difficulty on all 111 untagged questions; rewrote 57 questions for retired or changed facts (gh-copilot extension -> Copilot CLI, knowledge bases -> Spaces, Copilot Extensions -> MCP, Spark retirement, legacy metrics API, indemnity no longer requiring the public code filter, Free/Pro training opt-out); fixed 16 options split by line wraps and 3 wrong answer keys; added Key Concept / In Practice / Exam Trap blocks to every notes section; corrected scenario facts.

Grew D2 from 35 to 61 questions (276 -> 302): 26 new questions on Copilot CLI (WinGet install, plan mode, -s, --continue, /add-dir, /delegate and its policies, --deny-tool precedence), MCP config in VS Code, subagents, agent sessions, cloud agent limits and copilot-setup-steps.yml, prompt files, path-specific and GitHub.com instruction precedence, code review file types, Chat on GitHub.com retention, Spaces and plan availability (6 easy, 12 medium, 8 hard). Rewrote ghc-d2-024 (alternatives are chosen by hovering; Alt+]/Alt+[ are not in the VS Code docs) and fixed ghc-d2-002's explanation; remapped all D2 question IDs to the correct task statements. D2 notes: corrected CLI auto-compaction (starts near 80%, not 95%), added /delegate, --continue, /fleet, MCP, subagent, cloud agent, code review and prompt file details; D3 notes: replaced unconfirmed retention wording with GitHub's documented Business/Enterprise defaults (IDE not retained, other surfaces 28 days, engagement data 2 years). Scenarios marked schemaVersion 2.0 so their 16 questions render as walkthroughs; removed duplicated 'A.'/'B.' prefixes from option text in 128 questions; scenario answers rebalanced (all had been B); multi-select ghc-d4-022 and ghc-d6-025 rewritten as single-answer (the quiz supports one correct answer); 4 unreferenced legacy question files removed after their questions were merged.
